title: King Asa's Reforms and War
description: King Asa introduces religious reforms in Judah, removes idols and deposes his mother Maacah as queen mother. Later, war breaks out with the king of Israel, Baasha, and Asa makes a pact with Ben-Hadad, king of Aram, to force Baasha back. In his old age, Asa is struck by disease in his feet before he dies and is succeeded by his son Jehoshaphat.
